project.title: Dynk Full Autonomous Audit
instructions: Run the audit end-to-end using the browser operator. Do not ask the user to manually navigate or capture screenshots unless a true human-only blocker occurs.

This is a read-only audit. Do not save, submit, delete, create, approve, reject, activate, deactivate, book, reserve, pay, refund, send, invite, reset, favorite, or otherwise change application state.
Use screenshots and structured page observations as evidence.
Only report findings supported by observed evidence.
Continue autonomously through safe navigation, menus, drawers, tabs, lists, details pages, settings pages, scrolling and back navigation.
If an action is blocked by the read-only guard, find a different safe way to inspect the same area.
Treat login, CAPTCHA, MFA, external-origin authentication or permission denial as human-only blockers.
deliverables: Confirmed findings grouped by Critical, High, Medium, Low and Observation.
For every finding: affected area, evidence, impact and recommended remediation.
Strengths and workflows that appear correct.
Mobile/PWA and accessibility findings visible from the audit.
Security/privacy concerns visible from the UI or browser-observed behavior.
Unverified areas and why they could not be verified.

tasks.title: Dynk Full Product Audit
tasks.next_action: Audit Dynk end-to-end in read-only mode using the autonomous browser operator, covering public/customer journeys, venue and booking UX, franchise/location operations, payments surfaces, platform administration, roles, consistency, accessibility and reliability.
audit_focus: Public directory and venue discovery.
Active and inactive venue presentation.
Venue detail pages, schedules, availability and day pagination.
Favorites presentation and limits without toggling favorites.
Open Play journey without submitting a booking.
Court Reservation journey without submitting a booking.
Walk-in workflow surfaces without creating records.
Manual GCash payment/proof-of-payment surfaces without approving or changing payment state.
Xendit payment entry points and configuration presentation without editing credentials.
Franchise settings and global rules.
Location settings: address, branding override, GCash QR, court count, schedules, slot duration, booking limits, availability and status.
Bookings, Open Play and Payments operational tables and drawers.
Super Admin platform statistics and administration surfaces.
Accounts and users administration without creating, editing or deleting users.
Password-reset and email-related administration surfaces without sending messages.
Super Admin, Franchise owner and Location user role/navigation differences visible in the current account context.
Tenant, franchise and location context clarity.
Search, filtering, pagination, row actions and status visibility.
Loading, skeleton, empty, success, validation and error states that can be safely observed.
Destructive-action safeguards and confirmation patterns without confirming destructive actions.
Desktop layout, responsive/mobile behavior where safely inspectable, PWA cues, accessibility and touch-target quality.
Cross-system copy, naming, hierarchy, navigation and component consistency.
Visible privacy/security issues such as exposed secrets, sensitive values, permission leakage or overly revealing errors.

subtasks.title: Map the current navigation and major product areas.
Audit public/customer discovery and venue pages.
Audit booking-related journeys without submitting transactions.
Audit customer-facing payment surfaces without paying or changing payment state.
Audit franchise-level settings and global-rule presentation.
Audit location-level settings, schedules, limits, availability and branding.
Audit operational Bookings, Open Play and Payments surfaces.
Audit platform administration, accounts/users and visible role boundaries.
Audit tenant/location context safety, action clarity and destructive-action safeguards.
Audit consistency, responsive behavior, accessibility and visible reliability issues.
Review visible security/privacy concerns and permission leakage.
Produce the final evidence-grounded Dynk audit report.
